exposure: EBV antibody responses (e.g., EA-D antibody titers)
cohort: The study included 283 children from the Finnish Family HPV cohort, followed for 3 years post-birth.
finding: Higher paternal education levels were strongly associated with lower EBV seropositivity in children, and children with the highest baseline titers of EA-D antibodies had an increased risk for incident oral HPV infection and its clearance.
